sources.title: SciPy barnard_exact
verified_findings: Fixed two-independent-binomial unconditional exact test; nuisance pi maximization.
Uses pooled/unpooled Wald ordering, not GLR.
Reference: Barnard1947, Significance Tests for2x2 Tables, Biometrika34(1/2):123-138, DOI10.2307/2332517.

sources.title: SciPy boschloo_exact
verified_findings: Orders tables by Fisher exact p-value, then unconditional null extremeness.
SciPy two-sided convention is twice the minimum of the two one-sided p-values; differs from default Fisher two-sided.
Reference: Boschloo1970, Raised Conditional Level of Significance for the2x2-table when Testing the Equality of Two Probabilities, Statistica Neerlandica24:1-35.

sources.title: R Exact exact.test manual
verified_findings: Supports Z-pooled/Score, Z-unpooled, Santner and Snell, Boschloo, CSM orderings.
CSM is identified as Barnard original method; computationally intensive strong comparator.
This documented interface does not list likelihood-ratio ordering.

conclusions: Exact unconditional tests of two binomial proportions with nuisance maximization are old prior art.
A nuisance-maximized GLR ordering is conceptually within exact unconditional test construction, but these verified callable interfaces do not implement GLR ordering.
Fixed-look p-values must not be repeatedly inspected without sequential error calibration.
Documented floating nuisance maximization is not our outward interval proof; comparison must state numerical validation scope.
Do not identify all Barnard tests with SciPy pooled Wald or claim our GLR is its implementation.
